{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMdNDs8AAAABZkUg4A", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnXy5zhDK8Cg", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnXy5", "number": 45, "title": "Reproduce a bounded PMX rigid-body and spring-joint profile through glTF, VMD/VPD and Demo", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `c9e24960ead487517ef0ad59b60748ab6a5cd822`, `tools/pmx-to-gltf.ts` preserves physics only as body/joint counts. There is no simulation backend or reusable physics lifecycle, and `packages/mmd-solver` rejects post-physics dependencies. Consequently, converted VMD playback and VPD poses cannot reproduce physics-driven deformation.

## Expected outcome

Deliver one bounded rigid-body profile across a runtime-independent extension, converter, reusable Three.js integration and the existing Demo. Support sphere/box/capsule bodies, PMX coupling modes 0/1/2, collision groups and type-0 spring-6DOF joints between two bodies. Integrate pre/post-physics deformation using the existing bounded IK/append algorithms and dependency restrictions.

Pin one Ammo/Bullet build suitable for Node conversion and the browser. Define timing, reset, seek, pose handoff and disposal explicitly. Use core joint TRS and sampled animation for resolved fallback; extend existing solver/VMD contracts where necessary. Preserve existing Toon/Outline and skinning conventions.

Soft bodies, impulse morphs, additional joint types, external parents and general multi-axis IK remain separate work with explicit diagnostics. VMD animation, VPD poses and every other agreed goal dimension remain mandatory overall work. This Issue does not establish complete physics or original-MMD fidelity.

## Context

The clean checkout and inspected remote main match the baseline. The [open collection](https://api.github.com/repos/takahirox/mmd-gltf/issues?state=open&per_page=100), including PRs, is empty. `tools/pmx21.ts` already reads body parameters and type-0 joint records. Existing package scripts provide schema/Node tests, glTF validation, Playwright browser coverage and production Demo preparation. Dependencies include Three.js 0.186.1, glTF Transform 4.5.1 and mmd-parser 1.1.4; no physics backend is integrated.

[PR #44](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/pull/44) reports 91 Node passes and focused browser passes after revisions. Its saved evidence retains an earlier full-suite failure and does not claim another complete-suite pass. Both inspected [PR-head](https://api.github.com/repos/takahirox/mmd-gltf/actions/runs/40074830733/jobs) and [merged-source](https://api.github.com/repos/takahirox/mmd-gltf/actions/runs/40075297679/jobs) jobs have passed build/typecheck/Node steps; browser execution remains in progress. Test presence, Coordinator reports and hosted results are distinct evidence states. No suites were executed for this proposal.

The [format-author PMX document mirror](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hirakuni45/glfw3_app/master/glfw3_app/docs/PMX_spec.txt) describes body/joint records and phase ordering; it describes format/editor behavior rather than measured original-MMD execution. [Core glTF](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KhronosGroup/glTF/main/specification/2.0/Specification.adoc) supplies metre-space transforms, skins and animation. Historical official [Three.js MMDPhysics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r169/examples/jsm/animation/MMDPhysics.js) supplies an integration reference, including coupling and body offsets, but its gravity and 1/65-second heuristic are not established requirements. [Ammo bindings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kripken/ammo.js/main/ammo.idl) expose spring-6DOF machinery; [Bullet stepping](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bulletphysics/bullet3/master/src/BulletDynamics/Dynamics/btDiscreteDynamicsWorld.cpp) demonstrates accumulation and substep clamping. Inspect the exact selected build before adopting its semantics.

Preserve the existing correction: **old assumption:** local append is ignored when its source also appends. **Corrected requirement:** local append takes priority. **Source:** the author's [0216b amendment](https://kkhk22.seesaa.net/article/312703073.html). **Rationale:** it supersedes the struck-through exception; local editing axes are separate. Original-MMD adoption remains unresolved.

Further evidence-backed corrections to AI-authored requirements are permitted. Retain the old assumption, corrected requirement, primary source and rationale in the Issue/PR. No human approval or independent AI re-review is required. Preserve the goal and justified acceptance; do not weaken requirements to fit unfinished implementation or failing tests. Implementation, testing, normal PR review and merge remain with the Coordinator.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Add an extension contract, schema, minimal valid glTF and invalid fixtures wired into `npm test`. Define identities/references, original-rest body offsets, shapes and dimensions, collision filtering, coupling modes, joint frames/limits/springs, defaults, processing order and core fallback. The minimal asset must work without PMX extras or material extensions. Version existing contracts without changing legacy semantics.
- [ ] Pin and record the exact backend artifact/version or commit, hash, license, embedded Bullet provenance where recoverable, required bindings and reproducible Node/browser loading. Serve required runtime resources through the existing build without an unpinned runtime CDN dependency. Keep backend loading and ownership explicit; do not introduce a general physics framework.
- [ ] Implement opt-in API/CLI conversion through BDEF/SDEF/QDEF and GLB/external-buffer glTF. Preserve supported body/joint payloads and source identities. Reconcile both parser paths, including whether handedness conversion already occurred. Specify rotations, reflected limit intervals, shape axes, metre scaling, mass/inertia, damping, friction, restitution, spring coefficients and collision margins. Label unmeasured mappings as project policies. Test raw collision bits through backend filtering rather than inferring polarity from `groupTarget` or copying historical code blindly.
- [ ] Validate counts, references, finite ranges, dimensions, group indices/masks, joint kinds and supported bone/body dependencies before output or runtime mutation. Define unbound-body behavior. Reject unsupported joint endpoints, ambiguous multiple body writers and unsupported dependencies with indexed diagnostics; failed conversion/loading must leave no partial output or claimed runtime ownership. Existing conversion modes retain truthful loss reporting.
- [ ] Implement the shared update sequence: sample raw motion/pose inputs, evaluate pre-physics deformation, update bone-driven bodies, step simulation, apply body-driven bone results, evaluate supported post-physics deformation, then refresh hierarchy, skin palettes and bounds. Specify mode-2 position alignment and offset composition. Prevent a subsequent animation write or repeated solve from overwriting simulated output. Surface, Outline, CPU queries and exports must consume the same resolved revision.
- [ ] Define a fixed-step clock, gravity in explicit units, accumulator ownership, overload policy and fractional-time rendering behavior. Sample animation at simulation ticks. Implement pause, resume, stop/reset, looping, forward/backward seek and VPD application/reset with documented velocity/force clearing and initialization. Seeking must reset/replay a bounded history or use an equivalently specified reproducible mechanism; never simulate a negative delta. Invalid or over-budget requests fail before changing the visible state. Test frame partitioning below the overload limit and the declared overload behavior separately.
- [ ] Add attributed synthetic physics variants of two distinct rig geometries/hierarchies. Exercise both VMD motions on both rigs and both VPD handoffs on each. Across the fixtures, cover all three shapes/coupling modes, unbound bodies, asymmetric collision masks including group 15, translated/rotated joint frames, angular/linear limits, nonzero springs and a post-physics consumer. Keep original fixtures and their provenance intact.
- [ ] Add independent analytical expectations for body offsets, free motion, coupling and phase order; derive finite-step expectations from the selected integrator. Use independently authored direct-backend cases for contact/spring integration and label that evidence separately from analytical and original-MMD evidence. State numerical bounds and measure contact/joint drift. Include disabled-physics, wrong-mask and incorrect-order controls with observable separation. Compare bytes, retained GLB/glTF and resolved fallback; validate generated assets with the existing validator. Preserve existing nonphysics tolerances and measure new fallback interpolation limits rather than claiming a continuous guarantee.
- [ ] Extend the built Demo using the actual converter/plugins: both rigs/motions through bytes/GLB/glTF, physics enable/reset and explicit stepping or settling, transport, both VPD handoffs, recovery and replacement/disposal. Cover BDEF plus focused SDEF/QDEF integration with vertex/group weights and Toon/PBR surface/Outline rendering. Pair measured resolved transforms with matching rendered revisions and saved canvases. Retain existing GPU position ≤1e-4 m, normal-component ≤5e-4 and raster limits when checking deformation against independently supplied resolved palettes.
- [ ] Export applied physics states as GLB/glTF, validate/reload and preserve their visible snapshot and immutable original rest without double simulation. Define whether simulation restarts or resumes; do not imply checkpoint continuation unless velocities and required state are actually retained. Test isolation of two model instances, asynchronous backend/load failure, repeated reset/disposal and release of owned native allocations and references.
- [ ] The Coordinator records actual results for `npm ci`, `npm run build` before generated-asset-dependent tests, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, Chromium installation, `PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_CHANNEL=chromium npm run test:browser`, `npm run check:links` and `git diff --check`. Integrate coverage into existing suites, preserving justified scenarios, thresholds and timeouts. Record environment, backend/asset hashes, numerical/rendered results, failures, skips and unperformed checks separately. This adds no independent AI review or post-merge test rerun.

## Optional validation

Controlled, version-labelled original-MMD measurements using the same lawful fixtures, particularly mode-2 coupling, spring mapping and post-physics append behavior. Keep them separate from backend conformance and synthetic analytical results. Native WebGPU observations and additional lawful representative assets are useful but are not gates for this bounded Issue. Original-MMD fidelity and representative integrated compatibility remain unresolved overall requirements.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed MMD/glTF model, VMD animation and
VPD pose reproduction goal. Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance
criteria when primary specifications or measured evidence establish the correction.
Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
